name: The Moonlit Glass Forest
description: A forest of towering glass trees whose leaves are delicate mirrors, reflecting moonlight and creating a dazzling canopy of starlight; fireflies drift among the trunks.
prompt: A serene Moonlit Glass Forest: towering translucent tree trunks with mirrored leaves reflecting soft moonlight, creating a shimmering canopy, fireflies floating gently between branches, gentle breezes rustling the glass, ethereal atmosphere, ultra‑realistic rendering, fantasy woodland.
caption: Walk beneath a canopy of glass that mirrors the moon—each step reveals a new galaxy of light 🌙🌳.
